clue.text: Cleaner fuel? Yes and no

parts.note: a char, or charwoman, is a British word for a cleaner of houses or offices
coal is the classic fuel burnt in a grate

explanation.surface: A question about whether some fuel burns more cleanly, answered with a shrug.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both wordplay and definition: the answer is a cleaner-burning fuel, and it is coal and yet not coal, hence 'Yes and no'.
explanation.definitionFit: Charred wood is a fuel that burns with less smoke than ordinary coal, and it is only partly coal by name.

clue.text: Chopstick?

parts.note: split the word into chop and stick: the answer means both to split apart and to cling together

explanation.surface: A one-word query about an eating utensil from East Asia.
explanation.walkthrough: The verb is famously its own opposite: one sense is to cut in two, the other to adhere loyally, so the single word 'Chopstick' holds both senses.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb has two contrary senses, to split with a blow and to remain faithful or attached.

clue.text: A large tree, or a small plant

parts.note: L is the standard abbreviation for large, as on clothing labels
a pine is a coniferous tree

explanation.surface: A choice between something big growing in the garden and something tiny.
explanation.definitionFit: A mountain flower of the kind grown in rockeries is a small plant from high places.

clue.text: The high point of a sea voyage?

definitions.text: The high point of a sea voyage?

parts.words: The high point of a sea voyage
parts.note: taken literally, the highest place on a sailing ship, the lookout platform at the top of the mast

explanation.surface: Asking what the best moment of a cruise might be.
explanation.walkthrough: 'High point' suggests a highlight; read literally it is the lookout perched atop the mainmast.
explanation.definitionFit: The lookout platform near a ship's masthead is physically the highest point aboard on a voyage.

clue.text: Sort of seeking stylish clothes

definitions.meaning: the phrase means somewhat, in a rough or imperfect way
read literally, going in pursuit of a style or trend in dress

explanation.surface: A vague description of someone shopping for smart outfits.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means in a rough way, and literally it describes chasing a current style.

clue.text: Uniform at school is vulgar stuff

parts.note: kit is a set of clothing worn by a team, a uniform

explanation.surface: A complaint that the uniform worn at a school is tasteless.
explanation.definitionFit: Garish, tasteless objects or art valued ironically are vulgar stuff.

clue.text: Cricket team Juliet follows on radio

definitions.meaning: the national side of a large South Asian country that plays Test cricket
in the radio phonetic alphabet the codeword for I comes just before Juliet, the codeword for J

explanation.surface: Listening to the cricket on the radio, with Juliet tuning in afterwards.
explanation.walkthrough: The NATO phonetic alphabet used over radio runs ... Hotel, India, Juliet ..., so Juliet follows the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: The country fields a Test cricket side, and its name is also the radio codeword for the letter I.

clue.text: It may offer a sandwich course

definitions.text: It may offer a sandwich course

parts.words: It may offer a sandwich course
parts.note: a sandwich course is a British university course with work placement in the middle; here it means a meal course of sandwiches

explanation.surface: An educational institution advertising a degree that mixes study with work.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain a sandwich course alternates academic terms with industry placement; read literally, it is a course of a meal consisting of sandwiches.
explanation.definitionFit: A counter selling light meals offers sandwiches, which might be eaten as a course.

clue.text: Quietly sing one tune, losing heart in clammy conditions

parts.note: to hum is to sing softly with the lips closed
I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: the central letter of the word for the tune is dropped, its heart lost

parts.note: a ditty is a simple song or tune

explanation.surface: Someone humming a little song in muggy weather.
explanation.walkthrough: 'losing heart' removes the middle T from DITTY, leaving DITY.
explanation.definitionFit: Moisture-laden air makes for sticky, clammy weather conditions.

clue.text: Take advantage of old bed one enters

parts.note: ex means former, as in an ex-wife

indicators.note: the numeral goes into the garden bed word, entering it

parts.note: a plot is a bed of ground for planting
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone getting into a former partner's old bed opportunistically.
explanation.walkthrough: The bed is a flower bed, a garden plot, not furniture.
explanation.definitionFit: To use something or someone selfishly for gain is to take advantage of it.

clue.text: Having pistol, loved to drill through card

indicators.note: the word for loved bores into the card, drilling through its middle

parts.note: a SIM card is the chip card in a mobile phone
dear means loved or cherished

explanation.surface: A gunman shooting a hole through a playing card.
explanation.walkthrough: 'card' looks like a playing card, but it is the chip card in a mobile phone.
explanation.definitionFit: A handgun carried at the hip in a holster, such as a pistol, is a weapon worn at the side.

clue.text: In men's room, set out failings of the elderly

indicators.note: set out is read as laid out afresh, so the preceding letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Something being arranged in a gents' toilet.
explanation.definitionFit: Brief lapses of memory are joked about as typical failings of ageing people.

clue.text: Sex goddess very exciting at first to students

indicators.note: only the opening letter of exciting is used

parts.note: NUS is the National Union of Students, a British student body

explanation.surface: A glamorous film star whose allure thrills young students.
explanation.walkthrough: The NUS is the UK's National Union of Students.
explanation.definitionFit: The Roman deity of love and beauty is the archetypal goddess of sexual desire.

clue.text: Thoroughly searched, managed to get fired

parts.note: to run a business is to manage it
sacked means dismissed from a job

explanation.surface: An office manager whose search ended in dismissal.
explanation.definitionFit: To turn a place upside down while looking for something is to search it thoroughly.

clue.text: Artist can't get anyone to pose for this

definitions.text: Artist can't get anyone to pose for this

parts.words: Artist can't get anyone to pose for this
parts.note: a painter with no model available paints a picture of their own face

explanation.surface: A painter's lament that no model will sit for them.
explanation.walkthrough: With nobody else willing to sit, the artist becomes the subject.
explanation.definitionFit: A painting in which the artist depicts themselves needs no other sitter.

clue.text: Youth's great need for excitement

definitions.note: youth plus 's, read as youth is, the 's being a link

indicators.note: the letters are stirred up, excited into a new order

explanation.surface: Young people crave thrills.
explanation.definitionFit: Being young is the period of immature years, a tender time of life.

clue.text: Cutter from the east

parts.note: a cutting weapon from the Orient, the curved sword of the Middle East

explanation.surface: Something that slices, coming from an eastern direction.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from the east' looks like a reversal signal, but it just places the sword in the Orient.
explanation.definitionFit: A curved single-edged sabre originating in the Middle East is an eastern blade.

clue.text: In trembling ecstasy, finally receive gems

indicators.note: letters that tremble shake about, so they are rearranged
only the last letter of receive is used

explanation.surface: Someone quivering with delight on being given jewels.
explanation.walkthrough: 'trembling' mixes ECSTASY together with the E that 'finally' takes from 'receive'.
explanation.definitionFit: Chatoyant stones showing a narrow band of light, like a feline pupil, are gems.

clue.text: Beating faulty machine tests

indicators.note: faulty suggests the letters are broken and must be rebuilt in another order

explanation.surface: A defective machine failing its trials.
explanation.definitionFit: Punishment, especially by thrashing, is a beating given as correction.

clue.text: Wonderful game Americans would play with owl

indicators.note: the answer would make the game only with the bird's name added, so the bird is taken off

parts.note: the Super Bowl is the championship game of American football
taken as written, the bird's name

explanation.surface: Americans enjoying a game with a bird.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer plus OWL gives SUPER BOWL, the American football final, so the game less the bird's letters is left.
explanation.definitionFit: Something excellent or magnificent is wonderful.

clue.text: Absolutely evenly

definitions.meaning: as in refused point-blank, completely and without qualification
in a level, smooth way, without bumps

explanation.definitionFit: It means both outright, as in denied outright, and in a level, even way.

clue.text: Taking pains to enjoy oneself

parts.note: taking pains usually means making an effort; literally, accepting suffering for pleasure

explanation.surface: Someone trying hard to have a good time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Taking pains' sounds like diligence; read literally it is taking pleasure from pain.
explanation.definitionFit: Deriving gratification from one's own pain or humiliation is enjoying suffering.

clue.text: Provide unusual trace

indicators.note: unusual means the letters appear in an odd, rearranged order

explanation.surface: Supplying a strange mark or clue.
explanation.definitionFit: To supply food or what is needed for an event is to provide for it.

clue.text: Having much of the same quality?

definitions.text: Having much of the same quality?

indicators.note: the answer is held within the words that follow, which have most of its letters spread across them

explanation.surface: Asking whether two things are largely alike.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters sit across the end of 'same' and most of 'quality'; the whole clue also defines the adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: Things matching in amount or value share the same quality, being identical in measure.

clue.text: Hear a heavyweight attempt to deceive

parts.note: to try a case in court is to hear it as a judge
a means one, written as the Roman numeral I
a ton is a very heavy weight

explanation.surface: A boxer in the heavyweight division trying to bluff an opponent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hear' is not a homophone signal here: judges hear, or try, cases.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to attempt audacious trickery to see what one can get away with.

clue.text: Moving north in earnest to be as close as possible

indicators.note: the letter for north is shifted to another position in the word

explanation.surface: Heading north earnestly to get as near as one can.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Moving' shifts the N of EARNEST from the middle to the front.
explanation.definitionFit: The superlative of near means the least distance away, as close as can be.

clue.text: Sorry, failing to keep a Catholic devotion

indicators.note: the jumbled letters hold the A, keeping it inside
failing means falling apart, so the letters of sorry are rearranged

explanation.surface: An apology for failing to keep up a religious practice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'failing' rearranges SORRY, which 'to keep' wraps around A.
explanation.definitionFit: A cycle of prayers counted on beads is a traditional Catholic devotion.

clue.text: Online factory work?

parts.note: online is read as on line, the work done on a production line in a factory

explanation.surface: Factory jobs done over the internet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Online' suggests the internet; split it as 'on line' for a production line.
explanation.definitionFit: Putting together parts on a production line is the work of building products in a factory.
